crossRefs.note: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”
translations.bsb: Then Joab came to Absalom’s house and demanded, “Why did your servants set my field on fire?”
translations.kjv: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
translations.asv: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
